newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Flextech to develop wafer probe cards.
newsitem.headline: Flextech to develop wafer probe cards.

text.p: Flextech Holdings Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary Spire Technologies Pte Ltd would design, develop and market wafer probe cards in Singapore under a Singapore $23 million programme.

The five-year research and development programme, undertaken with the help of the National Science and Technology Board, would reinforce Flextech's push into the back-end semiconductor market, it said in a statement.
It said Spire had entered a joint venture with Scientek Corp and other partners in Taiwan to set up a Taiwanese subsidiary to distribute its wafer probe cards and accessories.
